name: Cafe Pascale
notes: 5 photos: 1 and 2 are the same large laminated menu board (breakfast, salads/wraps, lunch classique/deluxe, burgers, quesadillas, specialites, panini's, soups) shot from two angles and merged; 2 additionally showed Combos and Sides sections cropped out of photo 1. Photo 3 is the Smoothies board. Photo 4 is a bakery case with printed name cards for grab-and-go pastries (no prices visible, included as Bakery) plus a coffee-bar chalkboard that was skipped as a drink-only list. Photo 5 is a handwritten daily-special chalkboard (Meat Lasagna special included; its listed soup flavors were treated as the rotating Soup De Jour already priced in the main menu and not duplicated). All bacon/egg/cheese/dressing/salsa add-ons and the dressing-flavor list were skipped as modifiers.
